thread:
alyssa: Hey team — kickoff for cloud marketplace listing prep (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need quick sync on legal artifacts, AMIs, and starter SKU packaging. Who can own the initial checklist?
marco: I can own the AWS AMI + infra bits. Will need AMI naming convention and test instances.
selene: I'll take GCP images and Pub/Sub webhook for activation. rough ETA 3 days.
alyssa: @marco @selene awesome. @legal_jordan can you confirm the EULA variant and required signatures for each cloud?
legal_jordan: Quick Q: do we want a single EULA with regional addendums or cloud-specific EULAs? Recommend single + region clauses to reduce churn.
ops_tara: For networking, we'll need a vetting window for VPC peering and KMS access. Ops can do the preflight checklist once roles are ready.
marco: Noted. I have a small script to tag AMIs: `ami_name=redwood-inference-{{version}}-aws-{{region}}` and a publish step. Will share.
selene: GCP image workflow: use `gcloud compute images create` + artifact registry. I'll paste a minimal snippet later.
alyssa: Packaging: product wants two SKUs: "Developer (pay-as-you-go)" + "Enterprise (reserved)". Need pricing slug and trial duration so marketplace metadata can be populated.
marco: Can marketing confirm price bands? pinging @marketing in separate thread but we can stub placeholders.
legal_jordan: For trials we need explicit trial terms. Will draft a 30-day trial addendum today.
ops_tara: Ops checklist items: IAM roles, KMS policy, AMI/image scan results, telemetry webhook URL, entitlement mapping.
marketplace-bot: Checklist status: aws-ami:pending, gcp-image:pending, azure-vhd:pending, legal-eula:draft, packaging:todo
selene: One blocker — Azure expects a VHD and a different manifest format. Anyone with prior Azure publishing experience?
marco: I have one previous listing; will help with manifest schema. Can we reuse `cloud-manifest-v2.json`?
alyssa: Let's avoid reusing without small diff. @marco please prepare a delta doc. @ops_tara will validate the manifest against each cloud's schema.
legal_jordan: Also require a CLA for any third-party imagery components. @marco please list third-party packages included in the AMI.
marco: Will run `dpkg -l | grep -E \"(nvidia|cuda|libc)\"` and produce a short inventory + licenses file.
selene: For GCP activation flow, I propose: purchase -> pub/sub event -> onboarding webhook -> entitlement assign -> sample API key returned. Any objections?
ops_tara: That's fine. We should also rate-limit onboarding endpoint and add a retry queue.
alyssa: Action items: (1) @marco AMI naming + inventory + publish script (due EOD +2). (2) @selene GCP image + webhook skeleton (due EOD +2). (3) @legal_jordan draft EULA + trial addendum (due EOD +1). (4) @ops_tara preflight checklist template + rate-limit plan (due EOD +3). I'll consolidate into a short runbook.
marketplace-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.ai/internal/marketplace/runbooks/listing-kickoff-1777779000 (status: draft)
marco: Sharing initial AMI script snippet here:
```
aws ec2 create-image --instance-id i-abc123 --name "$ami_name" --no-reboot
aws ec2 modify-image-attribute --image-id ami-0abc123 --launch-permission \"{\"Add\":[{\"Group\":\"all\"}]}\"
```
selene: Shared GCP snippet in docs channel.
alyssa: One more — packaging metadata: we need short description (<= 300 chars), 3 screenshots, support contact, and an SLA blurb. Product will draft copy but we need tech details by EOD +2.
marco: I'll attach AMI test instance IDs after the build.
legal_jordan: I'll ping compliance for export control check — might affect image contents.
ops_tara: FYI: CI image scan might flag CUDA drivers; we'll need whitelisting or splitting drivers out into a marketplace runtime layer.
alyssa: Good call. If scan fails, fallback plan: publish minimal image + post-install driver script.
selene: Noted. I'll add a postinstall script example to the artifact repo.
alyssa: Thanks everyone. I'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 10am PT to review artifacts. If anything blocks earlier, shout here. :thumbsup:
